W.note: Rotated SAT contacts with substeps, sleeping and a spring grab with release velocity give believable throws, but the only control is Reset and the hint text sits on top of a box on desktop.

X.note: Axis-aligned boxes never rotate or tip and the drag chases the pointer by velocity, so release throws are weak; click-to-spawn and a long HUD line are the only guidance.

Y.note: Clear Add, Gravity and Reset buttons, a readable hint and a dark mode with rounded boxes make it the easiest to use, though the boxes are axis-aligned slabs that never tip.

Z.note: Rotated boxes settle into believable leaning stacks after a pre-roll and the spring grab keeps spin and throw momentum, but there is no hint text and only a Reset button.
